title: Glance Mode: Card-folding behavior experimentation, stakeholder synthesis, and interactive prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: The Console Glance view needs a denser ‘card-folding’ interaction so teams can scan many rollouts and cost tiles quickly on desktops and tablets. This ticket captures the design experiments for folding/expanding cards, microcopy for folded states, and interaction rules for mixed content (metrics, rollout status badges, and cost sparkline). Goal: produce a vetted interactive prototype and visual redlines that devs can implement with minimal DOM complexity.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype demonstrates fold/unfold behavior for at least three card densities (compact, standard, expanded)
Folded card shows clear primary metric, rollout badge, and affordance for expansion; expansion reveals KPIs and action buttons
Motion specs (duration, easing) and reduced-paint implementation notes provided to engineering
A11y: keyboard-expandable, screen-reader announcement copy for folded->expanded transitions, and color contrast >= 4.5:1 for critical labels
Stakeholder signoff from PM and Eng on performance trade-offs and from Support on microcopy for failure states
decisions: Keep folded state minimal: one headline metric, one secondary metric (small), rollout badge, and chevron affordance
Use CSS transforms (scale + translate) and opacity for animation to avoid layout thrash; avoid height transitions where possible
Animation timing: open 200ms, close 120ms, easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.22, 1) for snappy feel
Limit expanded card DOM to lazy-load detailed charts and sparkline SVGs after 80ms to avoid heavy initial paint on large lists
Mobile gesture: support tap-to-expand only; no swipe-to-fold behavior in first iteration to reduce gesture conflicts
stakeholder_feedback: PM (Samir Chen): prefers primary metric to be 'cost per 1k tokens' in cost cards and wants 'paused' state visually distinct
Engineering (Priya Rao): requested low-DOM approach; asked for explicit notes about accessibility live region announcements and prefers 8px spacing baseline to minimize reflow
Product (Luca Bianchi): requested that rollout badges persist in folded state and that there be a visual hint for canary vs full rollout
Support (Hannah Li): provided microcopy for error and degraded states and asked that cards show a 'last updated' timestamp in expanded view
Security (Kelsey Morgan): confirmed no sensitive customer identifiers should appear in folded state; audit logs note should be available in expanded actions
visual_redlines: Chevron alignment: center vertically with badge baseline; 4px left padding from card edge
Badge contrast: increase orange (#F2994A) text weight to semi-bold to meet 4.5:1 against white; add 1px inner stroke on medium-density cards
Metric typography: folded headline uses 16/20 semibold; secondary metric 12/16 regular with 8px letter-spacing reduction in compact mode
Action buttons in expanded view: 40px minimum touch target; primary CTA uses brand blue with 2px subtle shadow to improve perceived elevation
Card elevation: compact = 0, standard = 4, expanded = 8 (tokens) using new elevation tokens; ensure shadow blur radius is consistent across dark mode conversions
qa_notes: Cross-browser: verify animations in Chrome, Safari, Firefox with GPU acceleration disabled to catch fallback behavior
Performance: open 100-card list in staging console and measure first-input delay; target FID < 70ms when expanding a card
Accessibility: keyboard tab to card, press Enter/Space to toggle; validate that aria-expanded toggles and a live region announces 'Card expanded. Showing metrics for <name>'
Edge cases: toggling while a lazy-load fetch is in-flight should keep spinner in expanded area; ensure no layout jumps when content loads
Responsive: test at widths 320/375/768/1024/1440 and ensure fold points follow density rules (compact auto at <640px)
Contrast checks: all badges and important chips must be >= 4.5:1 in both light and dark themes
next_steps: Incorporate PM microcopy edits for paused and canary badges (owner: Miguel)
Handoff to frontend with redlines and CSS prototype snippets (owner: Design)
Engineering spike to validate lazy-load threshold and DOM budget (owner: Priya)
Schedule cross-functional QA session on 2025-11-27 to test prototype in staging (owner: QA)
Gather telemetry checklist for rollout to ensure we can measure fold/unfold frequency and abandoned expansions (owner: Analytics)
